idea-plugin.name: Split Mode Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
AI chat assistant for JetBrains IDEs, built natively for split mode (JetBrains Remote Development) and powered by your own Ollama model source.

Split Mode Assistant adds an AI chat tool window backed by a local or self-hosted LLM through the Ollama-compatible REST API — no cloud account, no API keys, your code never leaves your infrastructure.

  • Ollama integration — point it at any Ollama endpoint (localhost or a remote server); models are discovered automatically from the endpoint, and responses stream token by token.
  • True Remote Development support — designed for split mode from day one: project access and all LLM traffic stay on the backend/host, only the UI runs in the JetBrains Client. It works identically in a regular local IDE.
  • Project-aware answers — the contents of your open files are provided to the model as context, collected safely on the host.
  • Multi-IDE — platform-only APIs: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Ideal for teams using JetBrains Remote Development / remote dev containers who want an AI coding assistant with a self-hosted model — local LLM, private AI, Ollama, split mode, remote backend.
